title: Little Coaster
description: A miniature roller coaster on a playroom floor: a looping track, a ferris wheel, toy blocks and crayons, rendered with Defold PBR. FlexYourBrain's entry to the Defold "Tiny Worlds" community challenge.
author: FlexYourBrain
controls: Play button starts the ride; settings in the corner.
credits: All assets made from scratch for the challenge by FlexYourBrain, per the project README.
Depends on vantage (Jhonny Göransson) and dirtylarry (Sven Andersson), both Lua.
